title: rxdiag emulator CSMA control: nRF root + nRF leaf, sync-vs-raw-async RX (R4 baseline)

test.description: CSMA control (rung R4) in the emulator: nRF root + nRF leaf. The leaf runs BOTH [SU] sync and [RAW] async listeners; the root sweeps sizes {700..1000} to both. Expected (like TSCH): both paths receive every size. Establishes the CSMA emulator baseline the HW CSMA control is compared against.
